column1: # A reference battery shaped for the Models window's "Best for" box, with the same columns as
# speech's measurements.tsv. Every model id here is one of Tests/fixtures/catalog.json's rows,
# because a suggestion may only name a model the catalog lists.
# The rows are chosen to exercise the picks: English has a clear winner and a much faster row
# close behind it; LibriSpeech English picks a different model, which the box has to report as a
# second answer; Polish has two rows half a point apart where the cheaper one is much smaller and
# is not downloaded; German is measured for recordings only, so its live line has to say so.
